system.name: Notes
system.purpose: A tiny notes service used as a test fixture.

boundaries.label: Notes host
boundaries.claim: Everything inside runs in one process.

components.name: Browser client
components.responsibility: Lets a person write and read notes.

components.name: Notes API
components.responsibility: Validates note requests and reads or writes the store.

components.name: Note store
components.responsibility: Keeps every note durably on disk.

facts.claim: The client never reaches the store directly.
facts.because: All writes are validated by the API.

glossary.definition: One piece of plain text a person saved.

questions.title: How a note is saved
questions.ask: What happens when a person saves a note?
questions.answer: The client posts to the API, which validates and writes the store.
questions.context: Saving is the only write path.
questions.narrative: Start at the client. It sends JSON to the Notes API; the API writes a row into the store.

questions.title: How a note is read
questions.ask: How does a note come back?
questions.answer: The API reads it from the store.
